finalSummary: docs/adr/0004-committed-platform-target.md states the operator ruling recorded as opum-doc ODOC-316. The committed target is macOS, Linux and Windows. The first developer preview is macOS-only. Linux (verified persistent, protected backend) and Windows (Credential Manager) each ship only after their own T26 run, and untested platforms are not advertised. The spec's §2 Portability row now names Windows and points to the ADR. WCLI-21 and WCLI-22 cite ODOC-316. Verified: lore validate --strict and lore check --strict exit 0 (5 files, no errors), and CI ran on this PR. Satisfies opum-agent OPAG-675 criterion 3.
